Manifest.Name: Eleanor Story Expand / 上层区的富家千金爱上在下层区开当铺的我：埃莉诺剧情扩展
Manifest.Author: EleanorRomance Team
Manifest.Description: 1.04 remakes the common story and all four routes: romance, harem, attendant and revolution. Includes the author-rewritten harem finale, window-based kiosk staging, revised dialogue, new portraits and expressions, route handoff/save-resume fixes, real trade goods and conditional story corrections. Simplified Chinese / English. Mature themes; no explicit R18 scenes. 1.04 重制共同剧情与恋爱线、后宫线、侍从线、革命军线，接入作者重写的后宫终章，修正售卖亭窗口内外的动作与空间事实；同步对白、立绘与表情，修复路线交接、存档续读、真实货物交割及条件对白。简体中文 / English；成熟向，不直接出现R18场景。
